summary: Email not sending after changing the invoice date
reported_issue: On the invoice screen within a Work Order, changing the invoice date and then trying to send the invoice by email caused the system to keep spinning; the email was never sent.
expected_after_fix: After Email -> Send, the invoice email should be sent immediately without any delay or loading issue.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened an invoiced Work Order (S9-24669) Finance tab.
Clicked Send Email (button_send_email); the 'Sending invoice' dialog opened pre-populated with the customer contact and email content.
Clicked Send Email in the dialog and timed the request.
Exercised the invoice lifecycle (reverse -> re-create invoice) to look for an invoice-date-change control in the create flow.
actual_now: Sending the invoice email works correctly: POST /api/work-order/invoice/send-email returns HTTP 201 in ~1-2 seconds, a 'Successfully sent invoice to email.' success toast appears, and the dialog closes cleanly with no hanging spinner. Creating the invoice auto-assigns the invoice date; no perpetual-spinner / email-never-sent behavior was observed at any point.
notes: Could not locate a standalone 'edit invoice date' control on an already-invoiced WO (Create Invoice auto-dates the invoice), so the exact date-change-then-email sequence could not be isolated. However, the reported failure symptom (spinner hangs, email never sent) does not reproduce: the send-email endpoint is healthy and responds quickly with success. Reversed and re-created the invoice on S9-24669 during testing (staging is disposable); it was left in the Invoiced state.
